title: Research Videos That Outperform Their Channels
job_text: Scan a niche and competitor channels to find videos that get 3x more views than the channel median in the first 48 hours. Extract key information about each outlier video, including title, content, format, and thumbnail, without copying titles or uploading content.
what_happened: This job involves using a YouTube outlier researcher to analyze videos that perform exceptionally well in a specific niche. The researcher identifies videos that receive three times more views than the median views on their respective channels within the first 48 hours. The findings are then documented in a weekly markdown format, providing insights into the format and structure of successful videos without copying their titles or content.
